experimentContext: Use the user's normal channel context: anonymous where no account is required and signed in where the marketplace requires an account.
tipPolicy: Set optional pickup tips to $0 before recording a final checkout total.
comparisonStatus: Uber Eats was $0.69 cheaper than the restaurant's Slice-powered direct checkout for one equivalent Kips Bay Deli basket captured within 50 seconds.
limitations: This is one basket at one restaurant on one date, not evidence of a persistent cheapest channel.
The direct checkout was anonymous and Uber Eats was signed in because those were the user's normal available paths; account context is recorded per observation.
DoorDash was excluded because its similarly named search result resolved to a different physical address.
No observed promotion applied to this basket.
